clips.title: The story
paras: In north-central Elwynn, Jasperlode Mine lies lost to kobolds and giant spiders. Its shafts once supplied Stormwind City with vital iron and minerals, but the resource-strapped kingdom cannot reclaim them.

Jasperlode Mine once supplied Stormwind with a steady wealth of minerals, alongside nearby Fargodeep. With the kingdom's forces stretched thin by outside threats and unrest, local garrisons cannot protect the shafts. Kobolds seized their chance, drove out the human miners, and hoarded stolen gold and tallow candles.

Deep within Jasperlode Mine, mine spiders have taken hold beneath the timber supports. A massive matriarch called Mother Fang leads them. The spiders prey on trespassing kobolds and unwary prospectors, making any attempt to salvage the mine dangerous.
